[COMPANY_LEGAL_NAME]
RISK REGISTER TEMPLATE

Purpose

This Risk Register Template provides [COMPANY_LEGAL_NAME] with a standardized format for identifying, documenting, assessing, tracking, and managing information security and business risks. This register serves as the centralized repository for organizational risk management activities.

Scope

This template applies to all [COMPANY_NAME] risk management activities including organizational risk assessments, project risk assessments, system risk assessments, and vendor risk assessments. It applies to all personnel involved in risk identification and management.

Governance and Cross-Package References

This template supports risk management across all [COMPANY_ABBREVIATION] compliance packages.

Cross-Package Integration:
security-governance skill (Security & Compliance Handbook): Master governance document establishing risk management framework
internal-compliance skill (Compliance Management Framework): Compliance risk management integrated with this register
contracts-risk-assurance skill (Risk Assessment Template): Risk assessments feed findings into this register
internal-compliance skill (Vendor Risk Assessment Policy): Vendor risk findings tracked in this register

For risk assessment methodology, see contracts-risk-assurance skill (Risk Assessment Template).
For compliance risk management, see internal-compliance skill (Compliance Management Framework).

Risk Scoring Methodology

Likelihood Scale
5 - Almost Certain: Expected to occur in most circumstances (greater than 90% probability)
4 - Likely: Will probably occur in most circumstances (60-90% probability)
3 - Possible: Might occur at some time (30-60% probability)
2 - Unlikely: Could occur at some time but not expected (10-30% probability)
1 - Rare: May occur only in exceptional circumstances (less than 10% probability)

Impact Scale
5 - Critical: Catastrophic impact; business survival threatened; major regulatory penalties; widespread data breach affecting thousands of records
4 - Major: Significant impact; major business disruption exceeding 72 hours; significant regulatory fines; data breach affecting hundreds of records
3 - Moderate: Moderate impact; business disruption 24-72 hours; regulatory scrutiny; data breach affecting tens of records; significant financial loss
2 - Minor: Minor impact; business disruption under 24 hours; minor regulatory findings; limited data exposure; moderate financial loss
1 - Negligible: Minimal impact; no significant business disruption; no regulatory impact; no data exposure; minimal financial loss

Risk Level Matrix
Critical (20-25): Likelihood x Impact score 20-25; immediate action required; CISO and management attention
High (12-19): Likelihood x Impact score 12-19; priority action required; CISO review
Medium (6-11): Likelihood x Impact score 6-11; planned action required; department management review
Low (1-5): Likelihood x Impact score 1-5; monitor and accept or address during normal operations

Risk Treatment Options
Mitigate: Implement controls to reduce likelihood or impact
Transfer: Transfer risk to third party (insurance, outsourcing, contractual)
Accept: Accept risk within risk appetite (documented acceptance with rationale)
Avoid: Eliminate the risk by discontinuing the activity or changing approach

Risk Register Management

Register Maintenance
Risk register reviewed and updated quarterly (minimum)
New risks added as identified
Risk ratings updated when conditions change
Treatment plan progress tracked
Closed risks archived with resolution documentation

Register Review
Quarterly review by CISO
Annual comprehensive review by CISO and management
Review includes: Risk rating accuracy, treatment plan effectiveness, emerging risks, risk appetite alignment
Review findings documented

Register Reporting
Quarterly risk summary report to CISO
Annual risk report to management
Ad-hoc risk reports as requested
Reports include: Risk metrics, trends, treatment status, emerging risks

Register Access
Risk register classified as Confidential
Access restricted to CISO, risk owners, and authorized personnel
Register stored securely on approved platform
Register backed up per backup policy

Roles and Responsibilities

CISO ([OWNER_NAME])
Overall responsibility for organizational risk register
Review and approve risk ratings and treatment decisions
Review risk register quarterly
Report risk status to management
Ensure risk register aligns with organizational risk appetite

Risk Owners
Manage assigned risks and treatment plans
Update risk status and ratings as conditions change
Implement treatment actions by due dates
Report risk changes and issues to CISO
Participate in risk register reviews

All Personnel
Report identified risks to management or CISO
Support risk assessment activities
Implement assigned risk treatment actions
Comply with risk management policies and procedures
